headline: MINDTRACE AI lets you solve murder mysteries with a local AI model
summary: Explore train locations, interview suspects, and use evidence to uncover inconsistencies in this AI-powered detective game. Runs locally using Gemma 4 and Ollama.
details: MINDTRACE AI is a browser-based detective game where players investigate a mysterious incident aboard a train. Instead of reading a fixed story, players explore locations, discover clues, interview suspects, and use evidence to find inconsistencies before making their final accusation.

The game combines AI-generated conversations with core game logic. Suspect responses are generated by Gemma 4 (gemma4:e2b) via Ollama, allowing the model to run locally. However, the canonical culprit, timeline, and evidence remain controlled by the game to ensure a consistent mystery solution.

This approach leverages open-weight AI models and local inference, enabling developers to experiment with AI-generated dialogue without relying on closed or hosted APIs. It highlights the power of open innovation in giving more people the ability to experiment, learn, and create.
The project was developed using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with an AI-assisted coding workflow helping with organization, frontend/backend implementation, and test preparation.

MINDTRACE AI is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 3: Slow and Steady. It demonstrates how local AI can be combined with web development, interactive storytelling, and deterministic game mechanics.
